caption:
The fastest reflex any anime fan has: hearing footsteps and closing the laptop before the door even opens.

Doesn't matter what episode you were on. The reflex is instant, it's unconscious, and it never gets slower with practice.

What's your go-to cover story when someone walks in mid-episode?

Save this for the next time you need backup.
